title: Proxmox virtualization
inventory_docs: operations/inventory/systems/ (hypervisors with tag proxmox or automation_targets: ["proxmox"])

services.title: Create LXC container
services.summary: Provision an LXC guest on a cluster node via the Proxmox API (ostemplate from config or flags).

services.title: Clone QEMU VM
services.summary: Full clone from a QEMU template; resolves the template node automatically.

services.title: List QEMU templates
services.summary: List QEMU templates in the cluster (use vmid for create-vm or provision.qemu.template_vmid).

services.title: Verify provision templates
services.summary: SSH keys, version-aware hdc API token ACL (PVE 8/9), Ubuntu LTS templates, NAS storage, scheduled backup jobs, host OS upgrades, QEMU guest agent report; optional --expand-guest-rootfs for usage-based Linux guest root disk grow.

services.title: Cluster inventory snapshot
services.summary: Query hypervisors and guests from config.json; JSON systems[] on stdout. Flags: --guest, --find-template, --host-capacity.

services.title: Reclaim over-mapped thin LVs
services.summary: --thin-overmap: report thin LVs that map more than their size (read-only). Add --apply --vmid N [--node n] [--temp-storage nas-1] to reclaim via a move-disk round trip.

services.title: Backup check and fix
services.summary: --backups: report failing vzdump guests with causes, job storage reachability/free space, stale locks, stranded disks, and job targets (missing/template/retired/duplicate). --apply clears stale backup locks and re-enables/activates job storage; --backup-now --vmid N runs a manual snapshot backup.
